## Come Find Your Island

It’s a perfect time to explore Prince Edward Island for cozy vibes, holiday shopping and a dash of good cheer.

[![Two people stop at outdoor CHristmas shop in downtown Charlottetown](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/Charlottetown_Christmas_Market.JPG?h=a53c6a59&itok=XF90e4kq)](https://www.tourismpei.com/trip-ideas/blogs/christmas-fairs-and-holiday-markets "Learn More")

### Craft Fairs & Markets

Looking for unique gifts? Do your holiday shopping at festive craft fairs and Christmas markets across the province.

[Learn More](https://www.tourismpei.com/trip-ideas/blogs/christmas-fairs-and-holiday-markets)

[![Two bowls of steaming PEI seafood chowder](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/50394964806_f6cb172c7f_o.jpg?h=34bbd072&itok=ktJcnigk)](https://www.tourismpei.com/what-to-do/culinary "Learn More")

### Food & Drink

Perfect moments taste better on Canada's Food Island in all seasons.

[Learn More](https://www.tourismpei.com/what-to-do/culinary)

[![Brooke MacArthur sings and plays guitar during Mistletoe Market](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/Discover-Charlottetown_Christmas_Festival_PEI_music.JPG?h=25afbe7c&itok=pZEyPXO9)](https://www.tourismpei.com/live-music "Learn More")

### Live Music

Tap your toes, sing along, and experience PEI’s lively music scene.

[Learn More](https://www.tourismpei.com/live-music)

[Learn More](https://www.tourismpei.com/where-to-stay/packages)

## \#ExplorePEIAuthenticated Traveller Photos

## Discover Prince Edward Island's Regions

[![St Peters Harbour, hills, lighthouse](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/%C2%A9TPEI017_NJ_St%20Peters%20Harbour_3943.jpg?h=df1a205b&itok=jn-j4h5V)](https://www.tourismpei.com/trip-ideas/itineraries/small-towns "Explore Our Small Towns")

## A Place for Everyone

Yes, Prince Edward Island is small in size, but you’ll be surprised by the abundance of adventure and activity that awaits. Explore our fishing villages, charming small towns, sprawling farming communities and thriving urban centres.

[Explore Our Small Towns](https://www.tourismpei.com/trip-ideas/itineraries/small-towns)

[![Food photography, oysters, lemon, flat-lay](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/%C2%A9TPEI019_SH_FIP_Studio_1578.jpg?h=df1a205b&itok=tUWzCImx)](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/north-cape-coastal-drive "Explore More")

## North Cape Coastal Drive

Beyond red cliffs and miles of coastline, here you’ll find houses made of bottles, a giant potato that stands 14 feet high, the Oyster capital of the world, happy Griswold and an entire alpaca herd and so much more.

[Explore More](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/north-cape-coastal-drive)

[![summerside pei](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/summerside-pei.jpeg?h=a19e7da1&itok=EZUdYFm1)](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/summerside "Explore Summerside ")

## Summerside

In this seaside city, you are never more than a few minutes by coastal boardwalk or cycling trail to local restaurants and cafes, historic buildings, cultural attractions and entertainment.

[Explore Summerside](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/summerside)

[![Confederation Bridge, field, hay, hay bales, sky](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/%C2%A9TPEI018_PB_Confederation-Bridge_6484.jpg?h=df1a205b&itok=ovDjlMQN)](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/red-sands-shore "Explore Red Sands Shore")

## Red Sands Shore

This route is named for its red sand beaches, cliffs and scenic heritage roads. Here you’ll discover artisans, theatre, expansive nature trails, makers of craft beer, wine, spirits and cider as well as views of the Confederation Bridge.

[Explore Red Sands Shore](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/red-sands-shore)

[![Anne of Green Gables, walking, house, sitting](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/%C2%A9TPEI019_SH_Anne%20of%20Green%20Gables_1276.jpg?h=df1a205b&itok=4TWBVamR)](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/green-gables-shore "Explore Green Gables Shore")

## Green Gables Shore

The quaint fishing villages and rural communities of the north shore inspired L.M. Montgomery’s Anne of Green Gables. Discover sandy beaches, amusement parks, coastal trails, world-class music and culinary delights.

[Explore Green Gables Shore](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/green-gables-shore)

[![Charlottetown Gay Pride, rainbows, umbrellas, women](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/%C2%A9TPEI018_BMI_Charlottetown_Gay-Pride.jpg?h=df1a205b&itok=uPKDDWX5)](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/charlottetown "Explore Charlottetown ")

## Charlottetown

Feel the energy of this capital city with the perfect combination of historic and new architecture and accommodations. Discover classic pubs, fusion restaurants, modern coffee shops and cafes, festivals and events, live music and world-class theatre.

[Explore Charlottetown](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/charlottetown)

[![Basin Head, couple, beach, water, cliff, trees, walking](https://www.tourismpei.com/sites/default/files/styles/card/public/media/images/%C2%A9TPEI018_SL_Basin%20Head_3766.jpg?h=9d98574c&itok=r3aIRVcU)](https://www.tourismpei.com/places-to-go/points-east-coastal-drive "Explore Points East Coastal")
